name: Central African Republic
description: The Central African Republic from Ubangi-Shari to independence in 1960, Bokassa's empire, coups and the war since 2012.

checkpoints.name: Ubangi-Shari
checkpoints.note: France founded Bangui in 1889 and ruled the land as Ubangi-Shari, much of it leased to concession companies.

checkpoints.name: Independence and Bokassa
checkpoints.note: Independence came in 1960. Bokassa seized power in 1966 and crowned himself emperor before France removed him in 1979.

checkpoints.name: Coups and war
checkpoints.note: Coups followed, and since 2012 armed groups have fought over much of the country.
